parsed.summary: The netlist implements the intended OPNhydro-r2 architecture: the ESP32-C6 DevKit is on the specified GPIO nets, pH/EC are each behind an ADM3260 isolated-I2C bridge while the RTD remains on the main I2C bus, the TPS62933/AZ1117 power chain and TMC2209 dosing-driver connections match the specified values and roles, and the pump/valve/float-switch interlocks are present. Reference-designator shifts relative to the specification and the documented firmware/hardware mismatches are not functional anomalies in the design files.
